RAW_INPUT_SOURCE: Untrusted bytes from dedicated catalog producer on exact enrolled channel
SOURCE_ID: Exact approved frozen PG18 source manifest digest
SOURCE_VERSION: Exact approved PG18 source version digest
stage0: Fixed-length prefix and envelope structure only. No SQL parser/type input/evaluator/module loader. Read integer lengths using checked u64; reject total/payload mismatch, >limits, unsupportedprefix, trailing bytes before allocating payload.
stage1: Walk bounded relation/row/field envelopes without interpreting PG values. Require exact source/version/schema/codec/context/generation/revision digests from independent expected challenge; exact19relation tags each once. There are146 projected field definitions TOTAL across19relations: each row must carry exactly the subset assigned to its relation tag in the closed codec table, never146 fields perrelation. Field nullflag and length validated against closed table; duplicate/missing/unknownmandatory/type/order/overflow/truncation rejected. Total row count<=MAX_RECORDS, each row<=MAX_RECORD_BYTES, each array count<=65536. No decoded facts released before whole envelope accepted.

transitions.PREPARSE_ACCEPT: Only then call finite closed canonical scalar decoders, never PG arbitrary type input functions; semantic predicate evaluation after complete canonical decode.
transitions.PREPARSE_REJECT: Any deterministic mismatch/malformed field or bound violation; no semantic evaluation.
transitions.PREPARSE_UNKNOWN: Expected enrolled identity unavailable; no semantic evaluation/qualification.

trust_boundary: Bytes cannot select SQL, relation queries, type functions or plugin names. Catalog producer uses fixed approved projections; its source execution/effective ACL remains independently checked by graph/reader contract, not solved by snapshot decoding.
original_SQL_ingress_subcondition: Original frozen contract also requires prevention of unapproved parse/type/planner effects within source producer; this producer subcondition remains under reader effective ACL/effect graph if source proof incomplete, never silently discharged by byte gate.
